name: memory-strategy-discrimination-suite
notes: This suite is designed to separate summary-only memory from folded/topic memory and reflection-based memory.
The current benchmark schema measures retrieval hits and summary term retention. Use docs/memory_strategy_eval_guide.md for manual and extended scoring.

Memory architecture decision: keep MEMORY.md as a lightweight pointer index, move detailed facts into topic files, run session-dream after long work, and use folded memory for old episodes.
